elevenlabsPrompt:
[intrigued] Crooked photos again? Your iPhone camera has a hidden level.

[confident] Here's the fix. Turn on the camera level.

[friendly] Open Settings, then Camera. Under Composition, switch on Level. Tilt until the line turns yellow.

[delighted] Straight horizons, and no cropping later.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
